adoption.rationale: Exact-pin review traces the model-controlled read path through the pre-tool hook, signed-snapshot exception, and fallback secret-read gate. The contract proves exhaustive membership for all 66 declared suffix spellings; the exact Node helper is separately replayed over path examples with a real source mutation.

contract.declared_domain: The formal domain is the finite, exhaustive set of 66 ASCII case variants of the suffix literals .pem, .key, .p12, .pfx, .kdbx, .age, .asc, and .gpg. For each literal, the source regex is used with search semantics. Separately, the product regression gate checks the exact pinned Node helper and pre-read gate on representative path basenames, Unicode stems, the .pub exception, and a source mutation; those sampled path checks are not an unbounded theorem about all paths.
contract.guarantee: The pinned case-insensitive SECRET_EXTENSION_RE matches every ASCII case variant of its eight declared private-key extension literals. The exact-pin product regression gate confirms that these extensions produce a blocking reason and throw for OpenCode read tools, including when preceded by ordinary or Unicode filename stems. This contract covers only the extension branch; other secret basenames, credential directories, and runtime configuration paths are separate rules, and .pub files are allowed by an earlier branch.
contract.input_source: The filePath, file_path, path, or pattern supplied in a model-controlled OpenCode Read, Glob, or NotebookRead tool call. quality-hooks.mjs routes pre-tool calls through checkSecretReadWithApproval; for this extension rule, source-access-approval falls back to checkSecretReadGate, which throws before the product executes the read.

domain: Exhaustive 66 ASCII case variants of the eight declared extension suffixes; helper path composition is checked in the product regression gate.
